mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS "userId", u.user_nm AS "name", u.user_nm || '(' || u.user_id || ')' AS "label" FROM tb_sy_user u JOIN tb_sy_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN tb_sy_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE u.user_stat_cd = 'USE' AND r.use_yn = 'Y' AND r.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY u.user_nm ASC, u.user_id ASC
SELECT role_id AS "roleId", role_nm AS "name" FROM tb_sy_role WHERE role_id IN ('PM', 'SALES_LDR') AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_ord, role_id
